title: Navimower 0.4.3-beta52

## US shared-account bootstrap
- Change the read-only `/vehicle/vehicle/auth-list` bootstrap to use mower-login-style identity fields after beta51 proved that the normal post-login body is rejected with vendor code `401900` (`token empty`) when no mower uid exists yet.
- Probe two bounded, read-only payload variants per mower-cloud host: login-style credentials with an empty common `access_token`, then the same identity block with `access_token` populated as well.
- Keep the value-free bootstrap diagnostics and add the payload variant name so the next live US shared-account test shows exactly which pre-session authentication shape the vendor accepts.
- No mower commands, account mutations, serials, uid values, tokens, or other credential values are logged.
